subject: [PATCH 07/11] nfsd: recall when a CB_GETATTR reply omits the size

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the NFSv4 callback code where a CB_GETATTR reply that omits the size attribute can cause incorrect file sizes to be reported. The patch adds a check for this condition and treats it as an error, causing the waiter to recall the delegation instead of reporting the file as empty. This ensures that the correct file size is maintained even if the server requests SIZE but the holder has changed it.
